title: Serverware Negotiated Response Observation Proof v2
description: Strict fail-closed successor to v1. This schema does not widen or redefine any v1 wire form. Verification purpose is verifier-side and closed: LIVE_AUTHORIZATION may yield the crate-private lifecycle capability only after current freshness/trust/revocation checks; ARCHIVAL_VERIFICATION authenticates immutable finalized history and can never authorize dispatch or state mutation.
$comment: Canonical JSON is UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS. Duplicate object members, floating point values, negative integers, and integers above 2^53-1 are forbidden. The verifier reconstructs one canonical staged-request commitment from immutable HTTP/1.1 request bytes, including canonical target, exact physical headers after injection, exact body bytes, framing, provider operation semantics, injection template/result, exact policy credential generation, and verifier-extracted provider idempotency. Policy, operation, dispatch authorization, authority prerequisites, custody, and every terminal bind that commitment. Exact immutable upstream response bytes are retrieved and reconstructed before bounded response-policy validation and attestation. Local acquisition uncertainty requires exact current and predecessor record/evidence retrieval or exact signed genesis absence, plus one proof-independent pinned store/cluster/credential-ledger namespace and canonical GENESIS predecessor state, a conflict key derived only from that immutable identity plus GENESIS or exact predecessor record ID, a linearizable CAS transition, threshold quorum, and separately administered transparency-log inclusion/consistency/no-conflict proof. Mutable ledger, checkpoint, or rollback assertions cannot partition the conflict namespace. Successful attestation and publication each require a non-null artifact-time trusted checkpoint with historical key/trust/non-revocation and runtime-attestation inclusion evidence; finalization-time evidence alone is insufficient. Credential authority follows the policy-committed closed primary/cleanup automaton and selected-path root; mode none requires both arrays empty and all other modes retain one combined maximum of eight operations. Recovery and dispatch roles require distinct current non-revoked keys. Read uncertainty is non-passing and has no write recovery seal. A conforming decoder MUST reject duplicate members before schema or typed decoding. This schema is only a closed structural prefilter: authority requires the crate-private Rust verifier, role-scoped signatures, trusted time, independent attestation, and immutable exact-byte retrieval.

canonicalQuery.$comment: Object member uniqueness forbids duplicate encoded names; RFC 8785 member ordering and Rust BTreeMap iteration define exact query order. With at most 32 pairs, 63-byte names, 191-byte values, and an 8192-byte path, the complete origin-form is bounded to 16384 bytes.

targetSha256.$comment: Commits the single canonical scheme, host, port, path, and query representation. Rust derives authority and origin-form path/query from these fields.

rollbackStateHeadSha256.$comment: Current independently attested rollback-protected state head. Local unresolved acquisition records must bind this exact head and epoch.

localAcquisitionUncertainSideEffect.$comment: For local-credential source, null means acquisition has no possible durable side effect and therefore cannot use an unknown outcome. Authority-plan source must be null.

credentialBindingSha256.$comment: Verifier-derived domain-separated commitment to exact provider, account, credential reference, version, generation, and local acquisition side-effect design.

Exact policy credential commitment for the provider, account, credential reference, version, and proposed output generation. Rust requires this for successful, failed, and transition-unknown OAuth records.

authorityPrerequisitePlan.$comment: mode none requires both arrays to be exactly empty. Required mode has a nonempty primary branch, and primarySteps plus cleanupSteps is structurally capped at one combined maximum of 8 authority operations; Rust enforces the same semantic sum and sequence bound.

credentialIdentity.$comment: Rust requires this exact identity for credentialMode=required and forbids it for both no-credential modes. The signed route profile repeats credentialBindingSha256 so local credentials cannot bypass policy generation binding.

localReconciliation.$comment: Rust requires this exact durable record for local-credential acquisition uncertainty and requires null for credential-authority uncertainty.

credentialAcquisitionFailure.$comment: The Rust verifier requires the branch to equal policy credential source and requires an authority failure to equal the signed authority terminal failure.

localAcquisitionFailure.$comment: Closed local acquisition causes only; authority, injection, staging, and dispatch failures are intentionally excluded.

localAcquisitionReconciliation.$comment: This object is only an immutable-object reference. Rust retrieves exact canonical record bytes through the trusted persistence interface and recomputes the domain-separated record digest, record id, retrieval id, and byte length before accepting any field.

credentialLedgerNamespace.$comment: Must equal the one proof-independent credential reconciliation ledger namespace pinned for the store and cluster.

pinnedGenesisStateSha256.$comment: Must equal the externally pinned canonical GENESIS state digest derived only from store identity, cluster identity, credential-ledger namespace, the fixed GENESIS marker and conflict key, and exact zero ledger-sequence/term/log-index/fencing coordinates.

predecessorSuccessorKeySha256.$comment: Verifier-derived conflict key over only pinned store identity, cluster identity, credential-ledger namespace, and GENESIS or the exact predecessor record ID.

ledgerId.$comment: Rust requires exact equality with credentialLedgerNamespace and the proof-independent authority pin; it cannot select a separate conflict partition.

localAcquisitionReconciliationRecord.$comment: Trusted retrieval returns this exact canonical JCS object, bounded to 65536 bytes. Rust recomputes ID/digest/length and enforces unresolved status, exact policy credential/request identity, one proof-independent credential-ledger namespace and canonical GENESIS state, a conflict key that cannot be partitioned by mutable checkpoint or rollback assertions, rollback continuity, and a monotonic ledger sequence/checkpoint whose predecessor is independently retrieved or covered by signed genesis absence.

ledgerId.$comment: Must equal credentialLedgerNamespace and the proof-independent authority pin.

localReconciliationContinuityEvidencePay.$comment: Rust requires exactly one predecessor or genesis branch, retrieves every referenced exact byte object, derives all IDs/digests/lengths, and binds continuity to the proof-independent credential-ledger namespace, canonical pinned GENESIS state, and conflict key derived only from immutable store/cluster/namespace plus GENESIS or exact predecessor record ID.

members.$comment: Rust requires strict memberKeyId order, no duplicate key IDs or key material, all members in the external store pin, and verified count at least the externally pinned threshold.

localReconciliationTransparencyLogProof.$comment: Rust recomputes the predecessor conflict key only from immutable store identity, cluster identity, the proof-independent credential-ledger namespace, and GENESIS or the exact predecessor record ID. The leaf and complete proof bind the pinned canonical GENESIS state, both checkpoints match the external pin, and the separately administered log verifier must establish current checkpoint signature, inclusion, append-only consistency, and no conflicting successor.

ledgerId.$comment: Must equal credentialLedgerNamespace and the proof-independent authority pin.

localReconciliationLedgerWitnessPayload.$comment: Rust enforces predecessorSequence+1=currentSequence, the one proof-independent credential-ledger namespace and exact canonical GENESIS state, a conflict key derived only from immutable store/cluster/namespace plus GENESIS or exact predecessor record ID, strictly monotonic term/log-index/fencing, a verifier-derived full CAS transition, an externally pinned threshold quorum, and a separately administered transparency-log inclusion/consistency/no-conflict proof.

credentialLedgerNamespace.$comment: Must equal the proof-independent authority pin; proof-selected alternatives are invalid.

predecessorSuccessorKeySha256.$comment: Must equal the fixed GENESIS conflict key derived from pinned store identity, cluster identity, credential-ledger namespace, and the literal GENESIS marker.

ledgerId.$comment: Must equal credentialLedgerNamespace and the proof-independent authority pin.

localReconciliationGenesisAbsenceEvidenc.$comment: There is one satisfiable genesis path: first successor sequence one, zero prior records, the externally pinned credential-ledger namespace, canonical GENESIS predecessor state with exact zero sequence/term/log-index/fencing coordinates, and the single verifier-derived fixed GENESIS conflict key.

stagingSha256.$comment: Domain-separated canonical staged-request commitment reconstructed from immutable bytes. It includes target, exact post-injection physical headers, exact body, framing, operation semantics, injection template/result, and verifier-extracted idempotency key. It excludes the derived dispatchAuthorizationBindingSha256 and idempotencyBindingSha256 fields to avoid digest cycles.

exactRequestRetrievalId.$comment: Domain-separated content-addressed retrieval identity derived from exactRequestBytesSha256.

exactResponseRetrievalId.$comment: Domain-separated immutable response-record identity over attempt, staged request, dispatch evidence, authenticated peer authority, wire protocol, completion state, and exact response bytes digest.

informationalResponses.$comment: Ordered exact 1xx heads preceding the final response. Rust rejects 101 protocol switching here and caps the aggregate informational plus final head bytes at 1048576.

physicalBodySha256.$comment: Digest of the exact octets after the final header block, including raw chunk-size lines, chunk extensions, per-chunk CRLF, zero chunk, trailers, and final CRLF when chunked.

bodySha256.$comment: Digest of the verifier-reconstructed decoded entity body passed to provider response validation.

closeCompletionReceiptSha256.$comment: Complete close-delimited framing requires equality with the trusted transport's authenticated EOF receipt. All other framing and truncated close-delimited capture require null.

protocolValidationReceiptSha256.$comment: Trusted transport receipt that the exact immutable bytes are a valid but unsupported protocol/framing instance, not malformed input.

oneOf.$comment: Rust requires unsupported-protocol exactly for non-HTTP/1.1 and the other reasons exactly for HTTP/1.1, matches reason and completion to trusted immutable retrieval, and never invokes provider validation.

credentialIdentitySha256.$comment: Signed route-semantic repetition of the exact policy credential binding. Required credential routes must match policy and every authority, staged, attempted, injection-result, dispatch, and terminal credential reference.

newTokenGeneration.$comment: The proposed generation for this attempt. It is committed only when oauthTokenResult.effectiveGeneration equals it.

newStateSha256.$comment: Effective post-result state digest: on success Rust derives it from the exact OAuth credential tuple, request, operation, authorization, prior generation/state, proposed/effective generations, provider request/idempotency identity, and issued-result receipts; on failure or uncertainty it is exactly priorStateSha256.

oauthTokenResult.$comment: Rust requires proposedGeneration to equal request newTokenGeneration and prior+1. Success commits effectiveGeneration=proposedGeneration with an advanced state digest; failure and unknown retain effectiveGeneration=priorTokenGeneration and the prior state digest. The full result is committed by the authority operation record, execution-state digest, authority root, and signed terminal.

credentialAuthorityEvidencePayload.$comment: Rust additionally requires this binding to equal the OAuth policy prerequisite, policy credential identity, route provider, operation request, terminal summary, and envelope credential state for successful, failed, and transition-unknown OAuth outcomes.

unresolvedReservationSha256.$comment: Sorted identities of successful or transition-unknown grant/quota reservations that remain pending, expired, ambiguous, or otherwise require reconciliation outside this proof.

credentialRecoveryBindingSha256.$comment: Rust requires the exact acquisition recovery binding for any unknown credential acquisition and null for all other cancellation terminals.

localReconciliationRecoveryEvidenceSha25.$comment: Exactly the separately signed local reconciliation recovery evidence digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null on every other cancellation branch.

localReconciliationRecoveryAuthorityKeyI.$comment: Exact verified independently pinned recovery key id on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationRecoveryAuthorityKeyM.$comment: Exact verified recovery public-key material digest, distinct from custody material, on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationRecoveryAuthorityTrus.$comment: Exact current trust checkpoint used to verify the independently pinned recovery authority; null otherwise.

localReconciliationRecoveryAuthorityRevo.$comment: Exact current revocation epoch used to verify the non-revoked recovery authority; null otherwise.

localReconciliationCredentialLedgerNames.$comment: The one proof-independent credential reconciliation ledger namespace on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationPinnedGenesisStateSha.$comment: Exact externally pinned canonical GENESIS state digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationPredecessorSuccessorK.$comment: Verifier-derived anti-equivocation key over pinned store, cluster, credential-ledger namespace, and GENESIS or exact predecessor record ID; null otherwise.

localReconciliationContinuityEvidenceSha.$comment: Exactly the signed predecessor/genesis continuity evidence digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null on every other cancellation branch.

localReconciliationStoreTransitionSha256.$comment: Verifier-derived full predecessor-to-successor CAS transition digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationQuorumCertificateSha2.$comment: Verifier-recomputed externally pinned quorum certificate digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

localReconciliationTransparencyLogProofS.$comment: Verifier-recomputed separately administered transparency inclusion/consistency/no-conflict proof digest on local acquisition-outcome-unknown; null otherwise.

recoveryAuthorityKeyId.$comment: Must equal the independently pinned current non-revoked recovery authority and differ from custodyAuthorityKeyId.

recoveryAuthorityKeyMaterialSha256.$comment: Digest of the verified recovery public-key material; must equal the proof-independent recovery pin and differ from custodyAuthorityKeyMaterialSha256.

localReconciliationRecoveryEvidencePaylo.$comment: Rust requires exact equality with verifier-retrieved canonical record bytes and derived identity, exact request and policy credential tuple, unresolved side effect/timeline, rollback state, storage proofs, the proof-independent credential-ledger namespace, pinned GENESIS state, predecessor conflict key, and exact custody identity. Recovery is signed by a separately pinned current non-revoked authority distinct from custody by key id and verified public-key material. The payload also binds exact continuity, verifier-derived transition, quorum certificate, transparency proof, and predecessor recovery or genesis proof.

finalizationCheckpointEvidencePayload.$comment: finalizedAtEpochMs and trustedTimeEpochMs must be equal. Rust binds this separately signed checkpoint to exact persisted bytes, terminal and persistence evidence, historical key inclusion and non-revocation, runtime-attestation inclusion, and immutable persistence/retrieval proofs.

artifactTimeCheckpointEvidencePayload.$comment: Rust enforces finalizedAt <= artifactAt = trustedTime = signedAt < artifactKeyExpiresAt, exact finalization/artifact/runtime bindings, historical key inclusion and non-revocation at artifact time, and rejects a key revoked at or before artifactAt.

localReconciliationContinuityEvidence.$comment: Required by Rust exactly for local acquisition-outcome-unknown; its exact persisted bytes are retrieved before recovery can pass.

localReconciliationLedgerWitnessEvidence.$comment: Required by Rust exactly with local continuity and carries the externally pinned monotonic store transition, quorum certificate, and independent transparency proof.

localReconciliationGenesisAbsenceEvidenc.$comment: Required only by the genesis branch. The predecessor branch requires null and exact predecessor record plus recovery-evidence retrieval instead.

localReconciliationRecoveryEvidence.$comment: Present exactly for local acquisition-outcome-unknown after trusted retrieval of the immutable reconciliation record; Rust rejects it on every other branch.

responseV2CanonicalFinalEnvelope.$comment: The verifier MUST reconstruct and compare finalization ID, attempt identity, body digest, authority artifact root, raw immutable response reference, released projection, and complete canonical envelope digest against identity and the legacy body. Schema validation alone cannot express these cross-object equalities.

finalizationCheckpointEvidence.$comment: Required for both purposes. LIVE_AUTHORIZATION validates it against current trust/freshness; ARCHIVAL_VERIFICATION validates historical trust and exact persisted bytes but cannot grant any lifecycle authority.

artifactTimeCheckpointEvidence.$comment: Required and non-null. Rust verifies historical trust, key non-revocation, runtime-attestation inclusion, exact trusted artifact time, key expiry, and immutable artifact retrieval at attestedAtEpochMs.
Required and non-null. Rust binds this artifact-time checkpoint to the exact prerequisite attestation and independently verifies historical authority at publishedAtEpochMs.
